categories.name: Policy Change
categories.definition: Whether or how the policy may change, and how users are told.

categories.name: Third Party Sharing/Collection
categories.definition: Disclosure of user information to third parties, or collection of it by third parties.

categories.name: User Choice/Control
categories.definition: Choices users have about collection, use, or sharing, including consent and opting out.

categories.name: Data Retention
categories.definition: How long user information is kept, or what decides the storage period.

categories.name: User Access Edit and Deletion
categories.definition: Whether and how users can access, correct, update, or delete their information.

categories.name: International and Specific Audiences
categories.definition: Practices for specific groups, such as children or residents of particular regions.

categories.name: Data Security
categories.definition: Measures that protect user information, or statements about its security.

categories.name: Do Not Track
categories.definition: Whether and how browser Do Not Track signals are honored.

categories.name: First Party Collection/Use
categories.definition: Information the service provider collects or uses, including how and why.

categories.name: Other
categories.definition: Introductions, general statements, scope, headings, dates, contact information, and practices outside the nine.
